capabilities: Copy the current note as JSON blocks via a Command Palette command
Convert headings, body lines, and bullets into typed ordered blocks
Generate block ids during export for ordering
Feed JSON into the JSON to Text Figma plugin
extras: Manual installation only (build and copy files into the vault). Known limitations: styling, tables, callouts, embeds, and images are not converted; editing notes can change block ordering/ids.
motivation: The README says the output is optimized to be pasted into the companion Figma plugin for fast case study page layout, implying the author needed this workflow.
problem: Moving written Markdown into Figma as separate text layers is manual work; there is no built-in way to get Obsidian notes into Figma's structure.

requires.name: Figma with the JSON to Text plugin

summary: Exporter that copies the current Markdown note to the clipboard as ordered JSON blocks (h1–h6, body, list) for pasting into a companion Figma plugin.
